title: Cancel or the close icon discards the window's contents
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A name, {Term-A}, that no term has.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-23 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type {Term-A} in Name.
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Click "New Credit Term".
  5. Type {Term-A} in Name.
  6. Click the close icon at the top right of the window.
  7. Click "New Credit Term".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name reads {Term-A}.
  • Step 3: the window closes; no toast shows and no {Term-A} row is added.
  • Step 4: the window opens with Name and both boxes empty.
  • Step 5: the Name reads {Term-A}.
  • Step 6: the window closes without saving; no {Term-A} row is added.
  • Step 7: the window opens empty again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-N3: “"Cancel" or the close icon closes the window without saving and clears its contents; reopening "New Credit Term" starts empty.”
